mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS binding_id, c.id AS candidate_id, c.source_code, c.label, c.address, c.address_hash, c.probe_status, c.candidate_seconds, c.manifest_hash, c.confirmed_seconds, c.confirmed_at FROM local_episode_source_binding b INNER JOIN local_episode_media_candidate c ON c.episode_id = b.episode_id AND c.id = b.candidate_id WHERE b.episode_id = #{episodeId} ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 33
